name: Al Mushahidah
registryBasis: Identity review only. An official Iraqi investment-map document places Al-Mushahidah among the nahiyas (subdistricts) of Tarmiyah District in Baghdad Governorate. The WUP entry labels “Al Mushahidah” as a settlement with an 813,506-person 2025 population, but neither the supplied point nor population has been matched to an official locality boundary or to Tarmiyah’s subdistrict. Baghdad’s property سند-and-map services are owner-specific and list selected land-registration directorates; they do not resolve whether this WUP entry is the subdistrict, its center, or another same-name place. No local registry or geometry is attributed pending identity resolution.

officialSources.observation: The official Iraqi investment map lists Tarmiyah District (قضاء الطارمية) and its subdistricts, including Al-Mushahidah (ناحية المشاهدة). This distinguishes the administrative subdistrict from a city/settlement but does not match the WUP point or population to it.

Iraqi Ministry of Justice reports online property deed and property-map services for selected Baghdad real-estate registration directorates; the service does not name Al-Mushahidah/Tarmiyah as the WUP settlement and requires a property owner request.

The official Ur government e-service application is for a property owner to request their deed and property map; instructions require national identity documents and say availability is currently limited to Baghdad Governorate. No application was submitted.
Baghdad Governorate map page is a general governorate map, not a parcel service or official point-to-boundary match.
